name: Fandango
description:
A padded upholstered bench that does the work of two chairs without the visual weight. Customisable in fabric, velvet, leather, or leatherette. Lives at the dining table, slides into the entryway, or works as the foot-of-bed seat. One piece; many uses.

Fandango uses our standard seating-grade construction — same plywood, foam, and stitching as our sofas. The seat is firm enough for long dinners and soft enough for a quick sit while putting on shoes in the entryway. Solid wood legs in teak or sheesham, hand-finished.

The versatility is the point. We sell about 60% of Fandangos as standalone accent pieces rather than as dining additions.
